sentences.text: Diana -LRB- stylized as diana -RRB- is the tenth studio solo album by American singer Diana Ross , released on May 22 , 1980 by Motown Records .	Diana Ross	Diana Ross	Motown	Motown

The album is the biggest-selling studio album of Ross 's career , selling nine million copies worldwide and spawning three international hit singles , including the US number 1 hit `` Upside Down '' .	Upside Down	Upside Down (Diana Ross song)
All songs are composed , played and produced by Chic members Nile Rodgers and Bernard Edwards .	Bernard Edwards	Bernard Edwards	Nile Rodgers	Nile Rodgers	Chic	Chic (band)
